claims.claim_text: We describe a CNN that learns the entire processing pipeline needed to steer an automobile.
claims.normalized_text: A CNN learns the entire processing pipeline to steer an automobile.

claims.claim_text: The groundwork for this project was done over 10 years ago in a DARPA seedling project known as DARPA Autonomous Vehicle (DAVE) in which a sub-scale radio control car drove through a junk-filled alley way.
claims.normalized_text: The project groundwork was done over 10 years ago in DARPA Autonomous Vehicle (DAVE) project with a sub-scale RC car driving through a junk-filled alley.

claims.claim_text: DAVE was trained on hours of human driving in similar, but not identical environments using video from two cameras coupled with left and right steering commands from a human operator.
claims.normalized_text: DAVE was trained on hours of human driving with video from two cameras and steering commands.

claims.claim_text: DAVE-2 was inspired by the pioneering work of Pomerleau who in 1989 built the Autonomous Land Vehicle in a Neural Network (ALVINN) system.
claims.normalized_text: DAVE-2 was inspired by Pomerleau's 1989 ALVINN system.

claims.claim_text: ALVINN demonstrated that an end-to-end trained neural network can steer a car on public roads.
claims.normalized_text: An end-to-end trained neural network can steer a car on public roads as demonstrated by ALVINN.

claims.claim_text: Our work differs in that 25 years of advances let us apply far more data and computational power to the task.
claims.normalized_text: Our work applies far more data and computational power due to 25 years of advances.

claims.claim_text: Our experience with CNNs lets us make use of this powerful technology, unlike ALVINN which used a fully-connected network that is tiny by today’s standard.
claims.normalized_text: We use CNNs which are more powerful than the fully-connected network used by ALVINN.

claims.claim_text: DAVE’s performance was not sufficiently reliable to provide a full alternative to more modular approaches to off-road driving.
claims.normalized_text: DAVE was not reliable enough to fully replace modular approaches to off-road driving.
